name: Constraint Incompatibility Framing
description: Replaces hypothetical procedural descriptions with formal scheduling constraints, defining the certificates as identifying specific subsets of constraints that are mathematically incompatible with the deadline. This forces models to algebraically deduce the threshold conditions (p1+p2 > T and sum(p_c) > T) from first principles rather than pattern-matching "routing delay" or "throughput saturation" to simple sums.
